title: The Lost Box
setting: A busy street with many small shops on a rainy day.

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

sentences.en: Anna and her husband Dan go shopping.
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) and her husband Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) walk down a busy street of small shops carrying shopping bags.

sentences.en: They like the little shops on this street.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢这条街上的小商店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) look happily into the bright windows of small shops.

sentences.en: Then a big box falls from a car.
sentences.zh: 这时，一个大箱子从一辆汽车上掉了下来。
sentences.scene_prompt: A big brown box falls from the roof of a passing car as Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) watch in surprise.

sentences.en: The address on it is thirty houses away.
sentences.zh: 箱子上的地址在三十栋房子以外。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) holds the brown box and points far down a long street of many houses, Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) beside him.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Dan pointing far down a long street with the box; the address and the number can't be shown.

sentences.en: Now real rain falls, and the box is wet.
sentences.zh: 这时真的下起雨来，箱子湿了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Heavy rain falls on the brown box in the arms of Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper), next to Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan); the box is dark and wet.

sentences.en: Without any umbrellas, they carry it there.
sentences.zh: 他们没有伞，就这样把箱子送了过去。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) walk through the rain carrying the brown box together, with no umbrellas.

sentences.en: Poor Dan: water runs down his beard.
sentences.zh: 可怜的丹：雨水顺着他的胡子往下流。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close-up of Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) in the rain, water dripping from his beard, with a funny face.

sentences.en: They laugh: this is the best fun today.
sentences.zh: 他们笑了：这是今天最开心的事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), both soaking wet, laugh together at a front door after handing over the box.
